Step 1: Determine offsets.  
Europe/Paris (1184) likely uses UTC+0 historically (before time zones standardized).  
US/Eastern is UTC-5.  

Step 2: Convert 08:00 (Paris, UTC+0) to US/Eastern (UTC-5).  
08:00 + (-5 - 0) = 08:00 - 5 = 03:00 same day.  

Step 3: Date unchanged (no crossing of international date line, just time zone subtraction).  

FINAL_ANSWER: September 20, 1184 03:00
